svg.aria-label: Time-unrolled causal graph of an agent-built world. The agent writes two pieces of code: the scene η and the behavior π. η sets the initial object state x0 and the dynamics of every step; π chooses each robot action u_t from the states so far; each action and state produce the next state, up to x_H. A direct write from the code to an object state, bypassing actions and physics, is forbidden. An intervention do(·) edits η. The evaluator checks geometry on η, dynamics on the object-state trajectory, and function on the whole rollout of states and actions.
